prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Original painted Shurima regional cover for a Heroes III puzzle window, assembled at 592 by 544 native pixels and gradually removed to reveal the real grail terrain underneath.
Primary request: Paint one coherent richly textured fantasy regional illustration, near-square landscape ratio 592:544. It is a decorative cover painting, not a top-down adventure map, not a fake map screenshot and not a literal town construction screen.
Scene: An inhabited Shuriman oasis caravan settlement among warm sandstone cliffs and old desert ruins. A near foreground woven awning, bronze water basin and weathered sun-carved roadside stone frame a path. Two small cloth-wrapped caravan travelers and one tall tawny feathered biped pack mount with leather saddlebags move through the middle distance. Layered ochre sandstone homes, linen canopies, worn steps, palms, pale dunes and a modest blue-green oasis recede toward far mesas. The mount must have two powerful running legs and a long feathered neck; it is neither a horse, reptile nor camel. No unique champion.
Style: Rich original Heroes III fantasy adventure miniature painting, compact prerendered/painted volume, earthy material grain, dark but natural contour separation, fine brushwork and readable large shapes at native size. Inspired by the level of detail and warm illustration treatment of an original Heroes III puzzle-cover painting, without copying its scene, architecture, people, borders or shapes. Regional subjects follow Shuriman desert-worldbuilding and original project forms. No copied Riot painting or sprite.
Composition: Slightly lower, frontal scenic view rather than isometric tiles; use the whole image, with varied foreground/midground/background masses and a winding open path. Natural contact shadows, warm upper-left daylight and a clear quiet sky. Good detail across every part of the image because all forty-eight pieces will be visible independently. Small figures remain part of the landscape, not splash-art portraits.
Palette: Warm sandstone ochre, tawny linen, aged bronze, restrained dark wine cloth and small turquoise enamel accents; dusty palms and clear muted oasis water. Opaque painted surfaces, restrained highlights, no neon glow.
Constraints: Full opaque rectangular painting, no interface frame, no puzzle seams, no text, no labels, no lettering, no numbers, no watermark, no grid, no map symbols, no giant floating Sun Disc, no mass Ascended, no European Castle town and no modern photo appearance. This is a completed own artwork candidate; visual acceptance remains pending separately.
reference_role: Original Castle/native surfaces and official LoR illustrations inspected privately; no reference-image bytes passed to generation or bundled
